Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Karan - 28 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 63 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Suresh - 30 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Karan stands on the terrace. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Karan, what's the plan today?"

[Karan ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Karan: "I knew it!"

[Karan reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
